decision_rule: Preregistered in wiki/plans/2026-11-01-geva-108-ceremony-cut-prereg (sections 5 and 6). Each blocking blocker's value is the share of an arm's passes that FOUND it; PR clusters are the units of the test. Primary: variant-vs-control alone in the LOSS family, one-sided at null zero, exact sign-flip over PR clusters, LOSS when p is below 0.05 (the post's section 6 then Holm-adjusts it with the two TB2 LOSS tests). NO_LOSS needs the margin-shifted test at 10 points and the 80% size rule; at this size it is expected to exit 2 with NOLOSS_UNDERPOWERED, which is never a claim. Otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHED. False blockers: per-PR counts averaged over passes, paired by PR, exact two-sided sign-flip, smallest drop that counts 0.5 per PR. An arm that stopped or has blockers recorded with coverage incomplete gets no verdict. The other comparisons are secondary and descriptive.

loss_family.reason: The ceremony cut is the one change under test, so the review LOSS family holds one test: is the unattended render worse than the full render at all.

comparisons.margin_reason: The review no-loss lane's margin (stacks round 1 plan, section 7), kept so the scorer and size rule run unchanged. Control sits near 10% blocking recall, so this margin can only bound a loss; section 5 says so.
comparisons.note: Primary. The ceremony cut, both arms on Claude Code's preset system prompt.
